descriptions.delete_file: 删除 data 记录；BAT 物理删除实体文件
descriptions.quarantine_file: 保留 data 记录；BAT 隔离 loser 书籍目录（合并后残留文件）
descriptions.keep: 保留记录或实体文件；SQL/BAT 不执行操作
descriptions.update_metadata: 更新 books/data 元数据；不移动实体文件

delete_file.description: Delete the data row from the incremental preprocessing database and move the physical file to quarantine.

quarantine_file.description: Keep the data row but quarantine the loser book directory (files remaining after merge moved data to winner).

keep.description: Keep the current incremental preprocessing record and do not generate SQL/BAT changes.

update_metadata.description: Update books/data metadata in the incremental preprocessing database without moving physical files.
